question: What is the 4‑antenatal‑checkup coverage by district and year, and which district has the highest coverage?

view.title: 4‑ANC Coverage by District and Year
view.note: Select a year to compare districts. The coverage is calculated as (anc4_completed ÷ pregnancies_registered) × 100.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The data are synthetic and may not reflect real-world values.
